newsitem.title: UK: Burmah shares gain as Hoare Govett upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Burmah shares gain as Hoare Govett upgrades.

text.p: Shares in lubricants group Burmah Castrol Plc rose on Monday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett raised the stock to "undervalued" from "hold" after recent underperformance, dealers said.
Burmah shares were up 22-1/2p at 10.05 stg by 1213 GMT in volume of 1.8 million shares, after on Friday touching their lowest level since July last year.

Analyst Rod Maclean at Hoare Govett said the recent decline in Burmah shares had left it trailing at a six percent discount to the rest of the UK equity market on the basis of its prospctive earnings.
Burmah shares came under pressure earlier this year as analysts cut forecasts to reflect the impact of the strength of sterling.
